title: Evasion numbers via zero-prediction
summary: Cruz Chapital, Goto, Hayashi and the author showed that the game-theoretic variants $\mathfrak{s}_{\mathrm{game}^*}^\mathrm{I}$ and $\mathfrak{s}_{\mathrm{game}^{**}}^\mathrm{I}$ of the splitting number $\mathfrak{s}$ are consistently different, although the corresponding two games differ only in a minor case. This result suggests that even if two relational systems $\mathbf{R}=\langle X,Y,\sqsubset\rangle$, $\mathbf{R}^\prime=\langle X,Y,\sqsubset^\prime\rangle$ are the same modulo a countable set $C\subseteq X$, the associated cardinal invariants might be different. We study this…
